Function/potential role in disease

Encodes a mitotic cell cycle checkpoint protein that regulates the onset of anaphase

Regulates MCM complex Subunit of minichromosome maintenance (MCM) complex

Participates in DNA mismatch repair.

A hyaluronic acid receptor that can interact with many other ligands found in the ECM. Primary idiopathic PF fibroblasts exhibit an invasive phenotype that was abrogated with treatment with anti-CD44 [39] Has been observed to interact with TIMP1 [83]

Regulates NPC2 secretion, TNF-alpha production, and cholesterol trafficking genes in an animal model of obesity [51] Regulates NPC2 secretion, TNF-alpha production, and cholesterol trafficking genes in an animal model of obesity [51]

Mutations in this gene can lead to GM1-gangliosidosis, a manifestation of which includes foam cell accumulation in the lungs (84] Mutations in this gene result in a lipid storage disorder. Functions in the regulation of cholesterol trafficking through the lysosome by binding to cholesterol released from low density lipoproteins taken up by cells

Induced by phagocytosis of apoptotic debris in monocyte-derived MOs and regulates collagen turnover [44]

Has been observed to interact with CD63 and overexpression has been noted to inhibit apoptosis in a CD63-dependent manner [83]

Has antiapoptotic activity through interactions with caspases as well as the TNF supertamily members TRAF1 and TRAF2 [85, 86]

Also known as CCN1. Implicated in apoptosis in fibroblasts [87]. Has been shown to play a role in Fas-mediated and TRAIL-induced apoptosis [88, 89] Plays a role in the positive regulation of apoptosis [90] Cell surface death receptor

Negative regulator of NFkB signaling

Also known as uPAR. Contains an SSc risk SNP. Pulmonary fibroblasts from patients with idiopathic PF over express uPAR and that uPAR ligation results in a hypermotile phenotype [40] Regulates phospholipid membrane asymmetry Also known as A20. Contains an SSc risk SNP (also associated with other autoimmune conditions). Negative regulator of NFkB signaling
